response.sql: WITH tallies AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), shares AS (SELECT archstat, tally, tally::numeric / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM tallies), compared AS (SELECT archstat, tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT archstat, tally, share, share - average_share AS above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: A project is counted once per archival status; a project with QC records under multiple statuses can appear in multiple tallies.

alternatives.interpretation: Tally each QC record's project reference, including repeated records for the same project and status.
alternatives.sql: WITH tallies AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), shares AS (SELECT archstat, tally, tally::numeric / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM tallies), compared AS (SELECT archstat, tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT archstat, tally, share, share - average_share AS above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
